started_at_note: UTC clock observation at initial input-read completion; subsequent manual assessment began at this recorded time.
manifest_self_hash_policy: Manifest SHA256 is reported externally after final serialization; a recursive self-hash is not embedded.

prior_knowledge_boundary.known: General conversation system/developer/user instructions, Korean style and workspace environment, and parent assignment describing a two-AI frozen review. No original substantive user task or design history was supplied.
prior_knowledge_boundary.not_read: Protocol, generation prompts, condition keys, run responses, README, docs, memories, old judgments, root review, original PDFs or source-page files linked in packets.
prior_knowledge_boundary.source_boundary: Only supplied target/source and reference_context_blocks in the three authorized input files.
prior_knowledge_boundary.parent_exchange_before_seal: Progress counts only; no semantic results or scores.
prior_knowledge_boundary.independence_limit: AI review in a fresh task context, not blinded human expert review and not an independent generation sample.

method: Manual per-item and per-requirement semantic judgment, manually selected evidence and rationales; deterministic overall reduction and literal quote validation only.
seal_permissions: 0444 on all three output files after serialization
